research_rationale:
EO 12575 (President's Special Review Board), signed 1986-12-01. The order establishes the President's Special Review Board on the National Security Council staff (Section 1), its study and reporting function (Section 2), administration (Section 3) and, in Section 4, termination 30 days after it submits its report to the President, which is report-relative and not a dated end. EO 12581 and EO 12584 later moved the Section 2(b) report date, first to February 19, 1987 and then to February 26, 1987. First end: Section 3(g) of EO 12610 (Continuance of Certain Federal Advisory Committees, signed 1987-09-30, 52 FR 36901-36902) names Executive Order No. 12575 among the orders revoked, and Section 5 makes that order effective September 30, 1987, so the revocation took effect on 1987-09-30. The same section describes the listed orders as ones that established committees which have terminated or whose work is completed; that recital is disclosed as context and as a possible earlier cessation, but it gives no date and is not an end.
